children.name: server.py · Yahoo pricing, technicals, options & screening
yahoo-finance.ts · Yahoo pricing, technicals, options & screening
Company IR sites / caller URLs (open fetch)

observations: Both god files are hubs, not layers: their 'shared' regions (server.py 1929 NLOC, yahoo-finance.ts 1663 NLOC) are helpers reached from 2+ domains (Yahoo client, EDGAR fetch, HTML/table parsing). Extract these first — every domain module split out later will otherwise import back into the god file.

SEC EDGAR is read from 14 separate nodes across both runtimes (direct URL use, not through one client). It is the single most important upstream and a single point of failure; consolidating behind yfmcp/clients/edgar.py and one TS edgar module would make fair-access/User-Agent policy enforceable in one place.

Open-fetch surface: 3 nodes fetch caller- or registry-supplied URLs (worker/src/yahoo-finance.ts#earnings, worker/src/yahoo-finance.ts#news, yfmcp/tools/earnings.py). These are the S-01/S-04 SSRF paths from ASSESSMENT.md and should sit behind one allow-listed fetcher per runtime.

Circular dependency: yfmcp/tools/earnings.py back-calls server.py through string-keyed _server_attr(...) — resolved here to server.py#fundamentals, server.py#sec. These edges are invisible to static import analysis and block extracting earnings without first moving those targets out of server.py.

The Python runtime reads the Worker's JSON registries (company-ir-page-registry.json, news-source-capabilities.json) from worker/src at run time, so Python packaging depends on the Worker tree; the IR registry has a second writer (the daily ir-source-discovery job).

Extraction candidates (cleanest seams): News & public events (one region per god file, ~3.3k lines each, no dedicated module either side) and the Thai SEC funds pair (already isolated in both runtimes, only touched by the router).

flows.name: An investor checks a company's latest earnings and guidance
flows.persona: Investor using Claude with the hosted connector
flows.description: The investor asks for the latest quarterly results and management's outlook; the Worker finds the 8-K press release on SEC EDGAR, extracts the figures and guidance, and returns them with provenance.

steps.label: Request arrives at the public MCP endpoint
Find the latest earnings press release
Pin the fiscal period it reports
Return the answer with source and warnings

flows.name: An analyst builds a valuation evidence pack
flows.description: The analyst asks for a citable evidence pack; the system assembles capital structure, dilution, guidance and consensus, stores an immutable evidence cut, and returns its id.

steps.label: Gather capital structure and dilution from filings
Return the pack and cut id

flows.name: A desktop user asks what's new about a company
flows.persona: Claude Desktop user running the local server
flows.description: On their own machine the user asks for recent news; the local Python server gathers Yahoo, newswire, registry-approved IR pages and optional Finnhub/Marketaux items, de-duplicates them and reports coverage.

steps.label: Local server receives the request over stdio
Wrap results in the standard envelope
